title: Light Masks · Kenney
og_description: Download this package (150 assets) for free, CC0 licensed!
use_cases: Window, doorway and arch light cutouts
Particle alpha textures for sparks, smoke and dust
Shader masks for screen-space lighting passes
visual_summary: A 152-design set of grayscale alpha light masks on a 512x512 canvas, provided in three variants: Default (white-on-black), Inverted (black-on-white) and Transparent (RGBA soft gradient). The collection covers spotlight cones and beams (sharp and soft falloff), radial gradient circles, propeller/fan-blade shapes, geometric window and arch cutouts, organic cellular noise, dotted star fields, and natural foliage silhouettes. All assets are designed as drop-in alpha textures for 2D lighting, shader masks and particle effects.

zip_inventory.note: og_description lists 150 assets; actual unique mask designs = 152 (each provided as 3 variants: Default, Inverted, Transparent), plus 1 root Preview.png = 457 PNGs total.
